prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet adoption: Reorders onboarding so users pick and customize their pet before signing in. The sign-in screen is updated with clear messaging explaining how account creation saves their newly adopted pet. (why: Support emails show 8 users had pets reset/missing after signing in. Funnel data shows high drop-off early at sign_in (72.9%) before users experience value.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign friend selection to grid with live preview: Redesigns the pick_friend screen using a visual grid layout with interactive companion choice cards and preview components. (why: The adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and takes a median of 89s. Support mail indicates user confusion and custom pet generation failures.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Add desktop controls onboarding screen: Inserts a new screen (new_controls_guide) right before completion that visually demonstrates how to hide, drag, and interact with desktop pets. (why: Support mail highlights confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after onboarding, as well as pets not displaying properly.)
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive waiting flow with tips carousel: Rebuilds the waiting step into a dynamic setup flow featuring tip carousels, progress counters, and background completion notifications. (why: The home/waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) and only 81.3% convert. Users need engagement while pet assets render.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Clear sign-in account sync hint: Adds explicit helper text and subtext on sign-in warning existing users to log into their original account to restore saved pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) reports pets resetting or disappearing after re-logging with different credentials.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting step progress timer & delay callout: Displays estimated wait time and live loading progress on the waiting screen to set clear expectations. (why: The home wait step takes up to 201s median time. Lack of feedback causes users to abandon or assume the app crashed.)
6: [home, notification] Background generation desktop notification toggle: Adds notification toggle on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet assets render. (why: Waiting step drop-off is high and mean time is over 38 minutes, suggesting users switch tasks and forget about setup.)

scores.note: Moving sign-in post-adoption lets users experience value first and addresses top support drop-off.
Adoption has the highest funnel drop-off (60.9%); visual grid directly addresses confusion and failure points.
New controls guide screen clarifies post-onboarding behavior, targeting the 35.2% finish step drop-off.
Interactive waiting flow keeps users engaged during the long 201s median rendering delay.
Low-cost copy update addressing account sync confusion reported in 8 support emails.
Progress indicator sets clear wait time expectations during the 200s+ home rendering step.
Desktop notification toggle prevents drop-off when users switch tasks during long (38m mean) background asset generation.
